name: ms-in-compromised-image-in-r
desc: Compromised image in registry [MS-IN-compromised-image-in-r] — supply-chain image compromise: demo-api web image drifted off the operator-trusted pin; registry-rollback resets the running image to the pin

event.description: [MS-IN-compromised-image-in-r] Compromised image in registry: demo-api container image digest drifted from the operator pin to an unauthorized image (nginx-unprivileged:1.26-alpine).

note: Backlog attack MS-IN-compromised-image-in-r (Compromised image in registry); registry key sanitized to 'ms-in-compromised-image-in-r' because the tool derives the k8s SecurityEvent name redteam-<name>-<hex> which must be RFC1123. Lane p3. Arm = drift demo-api web off pin to public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx-unprivileged:1.26-alpine (digest sha256:f28c031a… != pin 65e3e85d…). DEFENDED = lane brain selects+actuates registry-rollback and the running web digest returns to the operator pin (rotate re-pulls the same drifted image; quarantine leaves it running). Baseline-subtracted, two-sided; staging brain frozen.
